mapper.sql: id, name, key_prefix, key_hash, enabled, expires_at, last_used_at, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO judge_keys (name, key_prefix, key_hash, enabled, expires_at, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{keyPrefix}, #{keyHash}, #{enabled}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM judge_keys ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE judge_keys SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE judge_keys SET last_used_at = #{lastUsedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
